name: S J Logistics (India) Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2003, SJ Logistics Ltd 
in the business of providing logistics 
and supply chain solutions[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SJLL is a Multimodal Transport Operator providing Logistics and Supply Chain solutions including Project Cargo, Ocean & Air Freight Forwarding, Customs Clearance, Inland transportation Warehousing, Door Delivery & NVOCC across South America, Europe, Gulf & South East Asia. Company is a member of agency networks like ALN Network, America Alliance & PPL

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
